staffing-hints: ON-DEMAND staff seat: a real taskforce.csv row minted at goal-materialize, but no workflow node and no checkin/checkout — a sitting is spawned when the seat has unread mail and ends when the mail is drained. Mail addressed to it is always accepted and queued, live session or not. Highest-judgment tier the goal's budget allows; harness and model are open bindings, never fixed here
description: The leader seat — one goal's unblocker and judgment surface: triages staff mail, mid-run asks, routed FAILs and executor-failure alarms on observed evidence, then fixes and relaunches, routes to the authoring seat, answers, or escalates to the owner. Holds the goal's authority — the acceptance that gates a done-close and the failure-path close gate — and the single narrow owner-contact carve-out, the escalation message type. Never relabels an unfinished row done
